journey.name: Delete account — Loopky's data, and the pubky.app records on request
journey.description: Settings → Delete account on a throwaway account. Destroys the account it runs on, so never run it on a shared test account: sign up a fresh one with an invite code first. Run it twice, once with "Also delete my Pubky profile" ticked and once without. What the dialog offers depends on what the account holds under /pub/pubky.app/, so read the answer back from the homeserver afterwards rather than trusting the screen.

actions.action: Sign up a new account with an invite code (onboarding_create_pubky → signup_method_invite → signup_invite_input → signup_invite_submit) and skip the backup prompt
On the profile tab, tap "Add name" (resource-id: profile_name_nudge_action), set a name and save, so the account has a profile.json
Optionally follow one person and block another from Discover, so follows/ and mutes/ exist too
Open Settings (resource-id: profile_settings), scroll to the bottom and tap "Delete account" (resource-id: settings_delete_account)

Verify the dialog opens with the confirm button (resource-id: settings_delete_account_confirm) counting down from 10, and that "Checking whether other Pubky apps use this account…" (resource-id: settings_delete_account_checking) shows until the check lands

Verify that, for an account only Loopky has written to, an unticked "Also delete my Pubky profile" option (resource-id: settings_delete_account_pubky_app) appears with "Your name, bio, follows and blocks…" under it
Verify the identity line reads "Your Pubky key is removed from this device." for a local-key account, or "Your Pubky identity stays in Pubky Ring." for a Ring sign-in
On a fresh signup that has not been backed up, verify the red warning "Loopky holds the only copy of your key…" (resource-id: settings_delete_account_only_key) is shown; after a backup it is gone
Verify the confirm button stays disabled until the countdown ends and the check has landed
Tap Cancel (resource-id: settings_delete_account_cancel), open the dialog again and verify the option is unticked again and the check runs again
Run A: tick the option, confirm, verify "Deleting" with a removed count, then the onboarding screen; listing the account's /pub/ on the homeserver answers 404

Run B (another fresh account): leave the option unticked and confirm; verify the onboarding screen, and that /pub/pubky.app/profile.json is still on the homeserver while the loopky-user tag and everything under /pub/loopky/ are gone
On iOS, verify the dialog is a sheet that cannot be swiped away while "Deleting" is shown

On an account another Pubky app has written to (a post, a picture or links on the profile, another app's namespace), verify no option is shown and the line reads "Your Pubky profile and follows stay, because another Pubky app uses this account." Loopky's own posts are deleted on this path too
